cards.front: ¿A que no sabes cuál es la palabra inglesa más larga sin ninguna vocal?
cards.back: I bet you don't know what the longest English word without a vowel is.

cards.front: ¿A que no sabes cuál es la palabra de la lengua inglesa que más significados tiene?
cards.back: I bet you don't know which word in the English language has the most definitions.

cards.front: ¿A que no sabes cuál es la única palabra inglesa que termina con las letras «mt»?
cards.back: I bet you don't know what the only English word that ends in the letters "mt" is.

cards.front: Que yo sepa, «rhythm» es la palabra más larga en inglés sin ninguna vocal.
cards.back: As far as I know, "rhythm" is the longest English word without a vowel.

cards.front: Que yo sepa, «set» es la palabra que más significados tiene en inglés.
cards.back: As far as I know, in the English language the word "set" has the most definitions.

cards.front: Que yo sepa, «dreamt» es la única palabra inglesa que termina con «mt».
cards.back: As far as I know, "dreamt" is the only English word that ends in the letters "mt".

cards.front: Gianni Golfera se sabe de memoria 261 libros.
cards.back: Gianni Golfera knows 261 books by heart.

cards.front: Tom Morton, un taxista, se sabía de memoria más de 16.000 números de teléfono.
cards.back: Tom Morton, a taxi driver, knew over 16,000 telephone numbers by heart.

cards.front: Hans von Bülow se sabía todas las obras para piano de Brahms y Beethoven.
cards.back: Hans von Bülow, a 19th century pianist and conductor, knew both Brahms' and Beethoven's entire piano works by heart.

cards.front: ¿No sabrá por casualidad a qué hora sale el próximo autobús?
cards.back: You don't happen to know what time the next bus leaves, do you?

cards.front: ¿No sabrá por casualidad desde qué andén sale el tren para Londres?
cards.back: You don't happen to know what platform the train for London leaves from, do you?

cards.front: ¿No sabrá por casualidad cuánto cuesta un billete de ida y vuelta a Manchester?
cards.back: You don't happen to know how much a return ticket to Manchester costs, do you?

cards.front: No sé cómo decir esto, pero a finales de este mes cien personas serán despedidas.
cards.back: I don't know how to put this, but 100 people will be made redundant at the end of this month.

cards.front: La verdad, no sé cómo decir esto, pero algunas personas tendrán que ver reducido su salario en un quince por ciento.
cards.back: I don't know how to put this, but some people will have to take a fifteen percent pay cut.

cards.front: La verdad, no sé cómo decir esto, pero vamos a congelar los salarios de todos durante los próximos dos años.
cards.back: I don't know how to put this, but for the next two years we're going to freeze everyone's wages.

cards.front: Como sabes, Sally y Tim se conocieron cuando estaban los dos estudiando en la universidad.
cards.back: As you know, Sally and Tim met when they were both studying at university.

cards.front: Como sabes, empezaron a salir un mes después de conocerse.
cards.back: As you know, they started going out a month after they had met.

cards.front: Como sabes, Tim no les causó una buena impresión a los padres de Sally la primera vez que se conocieron.
cards.back: As you know, Tim didn't make a good impression on Sally's parents when they first met.

cards.front: Como probablemente sepas, los padres de Sally le presentaron a Paul cuando estaban saliendo.
cards.back: As you probably know, Sally's parents introduced her to Paul while they were dating.

cards.front: Como probablemente sepas, Paul presentó a Sally a sus padres y a sus hermanos.
cards.back: As you probably know, Paul introduced Sally to his parents and siblings.

cards.front: Como probablemente sepas, Sally presentó a Paul a sus amigos cuando Tim estaba de viaje.
cards.back: As you probably know, Sally introduced Paul to her friends when Tim was away.

cards.front: Como quizás sepas, Sally y Tim se prometieron dos meses y medio después de empezar a salir.
cards.back: As you may know, Sally and Tim got engaged only two and a half months after they had started going out.

cards.front: Como quizás sepas, Sally y Tim se casaron seis meses y medio después de prometerse.
cards.back: As you may know, Sally and Tim got married six and a half months after they got engaged.

cards.front: Como quizás sepas, Sally se quedó embarazada antes de casarse.
cards.back: As you may know, Sally got pregnant before she got married.

cards.front: Como bien sabes, Sally y Tim se divorciaron el año pasado.
cards.back: As you well know, Sally and Tim got divorced last year.

cards.front: Como bien sabes, Sally y Tim no se llevaban bien los últimos años.
cards.back: As you well know, Sally and Tim weren't getting along for the last few years.

cards.front: Como bien sabes, Sally y Tim nunca llegaron a conocerse bien del todo.
cards.back: As you well know, Sally and Tim never got to know each other very well.

cards.front: Sabes tan bien como yo que su matrimonio no iba a durar.
cards.back: You know as well as I do that their marriage wasn't going to last long.

cards.front: Sabes tan bien como yo que Sally no estaba enamorada de Tim.
cards.back: You know as well as I do that Sally wasn't in love with Tim.

cards.front: Sabes tan bien como yo que Sally se enamoró de Paul en el mismo momento que le conoció.
cards.back: You know as well as I do that Sally fell for Paul the minute she met him.
